stage0069_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$メラン$$
「Invaders will be within visual range in one minute」

stage0069_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So they've come after us, is that it?」

stage0069_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...To think we'd end up fighting alongside you...」

stage0069_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$バアル$$ is our common enemy.
　There's nothing so strange about that」

stage0069_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't understand what kind of man you are anymore」

stage0069_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That $$アムロ・レイ$$... what's he telling the Colonel...」

stage0069_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「There's no way that's true...!」

stage0069_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「This is a good opportunity.
　Not just for the Colonel, but in front of
　$$アムロ$$ and $$カミーユ$$ too, I'll show my strength」

stage0069_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That $$ギュネイ$$ person...
　He's awfully conscious of $$カミーユ$$, isn't he」

stage0069_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But he's an ally now.
　Isn't that reassuring?」

stage0069_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I didn't notice when they were enemies,
　but this seems like quite a lively unit」

stage0069_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You may be unhurt, but you were just shot down.
　Don't push yourself, $$マリーダ$$」

stage0069_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Thank you.
　But this is my duty」

stage0069_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't force yourself into a mold.
　Living that way will only make it harder」

stage0069_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Not that I'm one to say that）

stage0069_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'll pass on the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ too,
　but I refuse to be wiped out by things like these!」

stage0069_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アルト$$
「If they're going to try to devour us,
　I'll resist with everything I've got!」

stage0069_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this!
　I won't lose to the likes of $$バアル$$!」

stage0069_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you're that nostalgic, just come back」

stage0069_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$刹那$$
「You should be able to do that」

stage0069_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シャア$$
「It's not that simple.
　...All units, move out!」

stage0069_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$n
（Strange...
　They're the enemy, but their presence feels right...）

stage0069_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$葵$$
「Invaders and space monsters...
　Being popular with $$バアル$$ isn't a thrill though」

stage0069_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$隼人$$
「But why...
　Are you saying $$バアル$$, driven by
　destructive impulse, has us as its target...」

stage0069_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「This might be the key to understanding their biology」

stage0069_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If they've come, I'll just have to face them!」

stage0069_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We're close to Earth here!
　If we lose, Earth will be devoured by them!」

stage0069_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's right!
　I won't let things like these run wild on Earth!」

stage0069_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, engage the Invaders and space monsters!」

stage0069_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't forget that Earth is behind us!!」

stage0069_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$トライア$$
「Not bad.
　A collab between $c and the Red Comet, no less」

stage0069_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$トライア$$
「Even Crowe's cheering you on from beyond the grave」

stage0069_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Don't just go killing him off without asking...!」

stage0069_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Still exaggerating as usual,
　that Doctor Fox is...」

stage0069_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Does rejecting the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ mean
　fighting those space monsters and Invaders...」

stage0069_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But even if we accept the $$エタニティ・フラット$$,
　all that awaits is despair」

stage0069_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$n
「Yeah...
　We're moving forward, into the future」

stage0069_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$トライア$$
（Reassuring, isn't it.
　Now then, Red Comet... what will you do?）

stage0069_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シャア$$
「I have things I must do.
　The same goes for you as well」

stage0069_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$シャア$$
「Fighting alongside you like this isn't so bad...」

stage0069_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$, $$クェス$$...
　You two will remain with $c as liaisons」

stage0069_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シャア$$
「This is an order.
　I'm leaving $$クェス$$ to you, $$ギュネイ$$」

stage0069_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You don't need to say it.
　You want to stay too, don't you, $$マリーダ$$?」

stage0069_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$ learned the Zeon
　spirit at Palau.
　Next it's my turn to learn the world」

stage0069_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Very well, $$マリーダ・クルス$$.
　I'll grant your wish」

stage0069_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Her... I'm counting on you for Lady $$ミネバ$$）

stage0069_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$...」

stage0069_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Good chance to say this, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.
　I don't intend to forgive that incident」

stage0069_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「But you and that Unicorn pilot,
　I'll allow myself to expect something」

stage0069_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... alone with you, all the way to the $$レウルーラ$$」

stage0069_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ and $$ハマーン・カーン$$...」

stage0069_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$n
「What a strange feeling...
　There's no doubt they're the enemy, and yet...」

stage0069_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The next time we meet,
　what will have become of the world, and of us...）

stage0069_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シャア$$
「I happen to be a pilot as well」

stage0069_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「No... he's grown stronger than before」

stage0069_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（$$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　Did $$ゼロ$$'s vision erase your doubts...?）

stage0069_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Strong...
　As expected, $$ハマーン$$」

stage0069_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「This much is only natural.
　Nothing to be surprised at」

stage0069_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What is it, Daddy's Boy?
　Are you gawking at that person?」

stage0069_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Uh... yeah...
　That $$ハマーン$$ person reminds me of Shikinami...」

stage0069_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What are you talking about!
　You idiot!?」

stage0069_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... you two get along well」

stage0069_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ミサト$$
（$$シンジ$$-chan's guess... might be spot on）

stage0069_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I got stronger to bring you back」

stage0069_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
（Damn...!
　There was someone else besides $$カミーユ$$ to watch...!）

stage0069_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Strange, isn't it.
　We're supposed to be archenemies, yet fighting
　together like this, we're in sync...）

stage0069_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Are we changing... him and me both...）

stage0069_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シャア$$
（Can I... can humanity move forward...）

stage0069_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（$$シャア$$... what are you carrying alone...
　Where do you intend to lead Neo Zeon...
　lead the world...）

stage0069_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Answer wrong, and I'll have to strike you down...!）

stage0069_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（The atmosphere of $c that Lady $$ミネバ$$ senses...）

stage0069_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（What draws her in so much...
　Does it surpass even the light of Zeon...）

stage0069_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$クェス$$!
　Don't leave my side!」

stage0069_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm already a grown-up, you know!
　I don't need you playing guardian, $$ギュネイ$$!」

stage0069_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's not really what I meant...」

stage0069_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$クェス$$
「I get it!
　It's not guardian, it's boyfriend you're playing!」

stage0069_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$クェス$$
「When you're stronger than the Colonel, I'll think about it」

stage0069_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't forget you said that!」

stage0069_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$甲児$$
（Why were there Invaders
　beneath the Mycenae ruins...）

stage0069_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$甲児$$
（Does Mycenae have some link to the Invaders...?
　Is the fight with $$あしゅら$$ not over yet...）

stage0069_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$宗介$$
「Our first space battle in a while.
　I leave the adjustments to you, $$アル$$」

stage0069_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アル$$
「Then I'll opt to return.
　AS maneuvering in space is still in development」

stage0069_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アル$$
「Just being able to joke beats you, Sergeant」

stage0069_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$宗介$$
「Playtime's over.
　Let's do this, partner...!」

stage0069_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$ is watching!
　I have to show her what I can do!」

stage0069_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If I get stronger, $$クェス$$ will choose
　me instead of $$シャア$$!」

stage0069_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（She's here...
　Just knowing that puts me at ease like this...）

stage0069_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（In the end, maybe I still rely on her...）

stage0069_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$マリーダ$$'s words...
　I mustn't forget them...）

stage0069_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$バナージ$$
（For now, let's fight...!
　To protect the future... the possibilities...!）
